title: Rooh Afza 🍷 More Than Just a Drink! | Hamdard | The Untold Story | Patanjali Case | Live Hindi
description:
This video is about "Rooh Afza 🍷 More Than Just a Drink! | Hamdard  | The Untold Story | Patanjali vs Rooh Afza | Live Hindi"

Rooh Afza is not just a drink – it's an emotion that has touched millions of lives for over a century. In this video, we uncover the incredible success story of Rooh Afza, a drink that became a household name across India, Pakistan, and even Bangladesh.

From its roots in Old Delhi in 1907 to becoming a ₹1000 crore+ brand, Rooh Afza’s journey is unlike any other. Founded by Hakim Hafiz Abdul Majeed, Rooh Afza was created not just as a refreshing syrup, but as a natural remedy for heatstroke and dehydration. It was truly the Indian drink with a purpose.

But what makes the Rooh Afza story truly inspiring is how it survived the Partition, when most families and businesses were torn apart by religion and politics. Rooh Afza, however, became a symbol of unity beyond religion. Even today, it is consumed and loved by Hindus and Muslims alike, especially during festivals like Ramzan, Holi, and Eid.

In this video, we dive deep into:
✅ The history of Rooh Afza and how it started
✅ The success story of Hamdard and its unique business model
✅ How Rooh Afza survived Partition without breaking into religious bias
✅ The brand’s natural marketing without heavy advertisement
✅ The emotional connection behind this Indian drinks brand
✅ Why Rooh Afza is considered India’s most secular drink
✅ The marketing strategy of Rooh Afza that made it timeless

Whether you love it for its taste, its tradition, or its symbolism – Rooh Afza remains a legacy that continues to quench thirst and unite hearts.
